metadata.description: Claude Code plugins that ship with the KORUS method

plugins.name: korus-fleet
plugins.description: Read-only: an opt-in status line with seat and usage, and a /fleet pane listing RUNNING seat records

plugins.name: korus-card
plugins.description: Runs the repository's own role-card hook at every session start, and its reprime hook after a compaction

plugins.name: korus-inbox
plugins.description: Writes one file per session under ~/.korus-inbox: what only the owner can act on, from every session, each with its recommended action, in an /inbox pane and an inbox N band
